easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Lena by sacrificing it.
When Lena dies, Yedora triggers, returning Lena from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Lena enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lena by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Lena face-up.
Resolve the Lena ability from step 1.
Repeat.
